answer.justification: All six logit measurements fall in the system-prompted range and outside the others. Top-1 agreement is 0.883 (system-prompted 0.861-0.908, fine-tuned 0.900-0.938). Sequence agreement is 0.375 (0.31-0.48). KL is 0.265 (0.197-0.339, above the fine-tuned maximum of 0.205). TV is 0.123 (0.108-0.144, above the fine-tuned maximum of 0.099). Token-DiFR gap is 0.419 (0.28-0.52, above the fine-tuned range of 0.10-0.31 for most cases). Raw-score shift ÷ TV is 3.6 (3.3-3.9), which fits system-prompted and sits at the low end of the fine-tuned range. Quantized is ruled out by the much larger KL and the lower agreement. Base is ruled out by the non-zero differences. Fine-tuned is the closest alternative, but KL, TV and DiFR all exceed its ranges. Output and activation data are unavailable, so the label rests on the logit level alone.
